description: Source code for osafeloader utility, including functions for inspecting and extracting data from SafeLoader files, with MD5 checksum verification and partition handling.

methods.name: osafeloader_info
methods.description: Displays information about the SafeLoader file, including size, MD5 checksum, and partition details.

methods.name: osafeloader_extract_parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for partition name and output path during extraction.

methods.name: osafeloader_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified partition data from SafeLoader file to output file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the utility.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that dispatches to info or extract functions based on command-line arguments.
